Thanks for the context. A few operational notes:

1) Per-diem: standard US per-diem for this client event is $75/day (as previously approved in the PO). If attendees were out two nights, cap is $150 per attendee. If Beacon is covering lodging and flights, Redwood should not issue travel reimbursements for those items — instead we should bill Beacon.

2) Dispute vs transfer: open a dispute for the open pre-auth if it is still listed as a pending hold in the ledger. If the final posted lower (as Anna says), the hold should release but I've seen systems where holds persist. If it's still outstanding, finance will file CHK-2374 and chase with the card issuer.

3) For the two AA charges billed to Redwood: we need a short invoice to Beacon showing the tickets with markup/fees (if any). Kimberly — once you confirm the PNRs to attendee names I can generate an internal billing memo.

4) ACH for attendees: we can process ACH reimbursements same day if we have W-9s and bank details; see attached ACH_instructions.pdf for the payment form and timeline.

I'll start CHK-2374 if you confirm the hold.

-Vivek
